ai.title: Bengaluru: BWSSB to roll out AI-enabled smart water meters for commercial, bulk consumers in PPP mode
ai.description: The Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board (BWSSB) has decided to install Artificial Intelligence (AI)-enabled smart water meters for large commercial and bulk consumers in the city. While the BWSSB will soon roll out a pilot project involving 1,000 such meters, it plans to scale it up to cover one lakh connections, sources in the Board said.
ai.title_cn: 班加罗尔：BWTSB将以PPP模式为商业批量消费者推出支持人工智能的智能电表
ai.description_cn: 班加罗尔供水和污水处理委员会（BWTSB）决定为该市的大型商业和批量用户安装支持人工智能（AI）的智能电表。该委员会消息人士称，虽然BWTSB将很快推出一个涉及1，000个此类电表的试点项目，但它计划扩大规模以覆盖10万连接。
